description:
A call center operations manager needs to onboard a new outbound sales agent. Create a new user account in the Vicidial administration panel with the following exact settings:

- User (login ID): 2001
- Password: EastSales2024
- Full Name: Maria Gonzalez
- User Level: 1
- User Group: ADMIN
- Active: Y
- Phone Login: 201
- Phone Pass: test1234
- Hotkeys Active: 1 (enabled)
- Scheduled Callbacks: 1 (enabled)

The Vicidial admin panel is already open in Firefox at http://localhost/vicidial/admin.php (credentials: user 6666, password andromeda).

To complete this task:
1. Navigate to the Users section in the admin panel
2. Add a new user with the user ID, password, full name, user level, and user group specified above
3. After creating the user, edit the user record to set Phone Login, Phone Pass, Hotkeys Active, and Scheduled Callbacks to the values specified above
4. Ensure all changes are saved

Note: Some fields like Phone Login, Phone Pass, Hotkeys Active, and Scheduled Callbacks may only be configurable after the user has been initially created, by editing the user's detail page.
